\section{Normative scientific requirements}
\label{sec:requirements}

The key word ``shall'' marks a falsifiable v0.1 obligation.  The identifiers
are stable and sequential; a successor may append requirements but shall not
renumber these identities.

\subsection{Identity, input admission, and cause separation}

\Req{001}{One-way lifecycle}{Requested, effective, observation-resolved, and
realized AST states shall be distinct one-way objects; a later state shall not
rewrite the accepted request.}

\Req{002}{Observation identity}{Every realized AST bundle shall bind one exact
immutable observation identity and product-plan identity.}

\Req{003}{Detector occurrence}{Every detector coordinate shall bind an exact
detector/acquisition occurrence and its observation, not merely an array
position or optional design identity.}

\Req{004}{Admitted detector binding}{A detector-to-geometry binding shall be
either a proven observation-local row relation or an explicit keyed relation;
bare row coincidence shall be rejected.}

\Req{005}{Distinct detector identities}{Acquisition identity, selected
measured-geometry identity, and optional design identity shall remain
separate and shall not be substituted for one another.}

\Req{006}{Immutable ALIGN transfer}{AST shall consume the exact
\nolinkurl{SCI-ALIGN_TO_SCI-AST v0.1/r0.1} transfer bundle without
reconstructing, reinterpreting, or independently finalizing any transferred
fact. Compatibility shall preserve every required identity, semantic state,
ownership boundary, and typed-availability rule; a successor shall name the
revision it supersedes and map every semantic change explicitly.}

\Req{007}{No shaped substitute}{A missing required ALIGN payload, field,
record, plan, version, source relation, or parent shall not be replaced by a
similarly shaped or similarly named object.}

\Req{008}{No clock or mapping reconstruction}{AST shall not reconstruct
clocks, offsets, assignment, interpolation, gap/guard, continuity synthesis,
epoch, topology, or source mapping from transferred values or array shape.}

\Req{009}{Aligned-field typing}{Every consumed boresight or current
observing-state field shall declare identity, registry version, unit, unchanged
producer frame, topology, operator, exact source mapping/support, origin,
validity, and uncertainty availability.}

\Req{010}{Signal-independent coordinate availability}{A finite or requested
$x^A$ or $r^A$ numerical detector-signal payload shall not be a prerequisite
for an otherwise fully defined AST coordinate.}

\Req{011}{Paired signal provenance}{Transferred $x^A/r^A$ producer facts shall
retain their common source relation and origin/synthesis state and their
coordinate-specific numerical-validity and payload states without mixing or
cross-filling.}

\Req{012}{Five typed causes}{Detector-occurrence identity, signal-coordinate
validity and payload availability, ALIGN mapping validity, AST coordinate validity, and
downstream use-specific eligibility shall be represented as five distinct
causes with no implicit precedence, alias, or rescue rule.}

\subsection{Pointing support and correction}

\Req{013}{Producer selection}{A named pointing-support producer shall select
the exact correction record identities and native support; AST shall not
select a calibrator, replacement, or stale record.}

\Req{014}{Correction semantics}{Each correction shall declare vector meaning,
sign, ordered basis, coordinate-increment versus tangent meaning, arcsecond
unit, parent, support mode/times, covariance availability, and application
count before admission.}

\Req{015}{Explicit sign adapter}{A producer residual with the opposite action
shall be converted only by one explicit, versioned adapter whose direction and
single application are recorded; an ambiguous sign shall fail before state
replacement.}

\Req{016}{Constant support}{One finite correction pair shall realize the
\texttt{constant} mode of Equation~\ref{eq:constant-correction} over its
declared admitted observation support.}

\Req{017}{Bracketed-MJD support}{Two finite correction pairs with finite,
strictly increasing MJD supports shall realize
Equation~\ref{eq:mjd-correction} only for occurrences satisfying
$0\leq\lambda_s\leq1$.}

\Req{018}{No extrapolation}{AST shall neither clamp, extrapolate, choose the
nearest endpoint, nor reuse another observation for an occurrence outside
producer-selected correction support.}

\Req{019}{Legacy-span admission}{Two deliberately absent support times may
select only the explicit \texttt{legacy\_observation\_span} mode, using the
exact first and last admitted aligned sample identities/times in
Equation~\ref{eq:span-correction}.}

\Req{020}{Ambiguous support failure}{Mixed absent/present, reversed, equal,
non-finite, or otherwise ambiguous two-support encodings shall fail; a
one-sample span is admissible only when both endpoint corrections are exactly
equal and reduce to constant mode.}

\Req{021}{Current-state separation}{Pointing interpolation shall use the exact
ALIGN-admitted time relation, while field rotation shall use the aligned
current science-sample time/elevation; the latter shall not be inferred from a
pointing-support record.}

\Req{022}{Support covariance}{When support covariance is reported, AST shall
apply Equation~\ref{eq:support-covariance}, retain supplied cross-covariance,
and keep model, selection, calibrator, and systematic terms separate;
unavailable terms shall not become zero.}

\subsection{Detector geometry, field rotation, and composition}

\Req{023}{Geometry authorities}{Every selected geometry shall bind SCI-BEAM's
measured relative-geometry authority and limitations plus an exact named
observation-specific association or transformation authority and instance, or
shall be typed unavailable.}

\Req{024}{Complete geometry artifact}{The selected artifact shall declare raw
observation-local coordinates and, where applicable, horizon-fixed/derotated
coordinates; ordered basis/handedness; units; gauge; angle support; versioned
rotation law; pivot state; covariance; unresolved affine modes; exact APT
realization; occurrence binding; and complete lineage.}

\Req{025}{No inferred origin or detector}{AST shall not infer APT origin equals
telescope boresight, nominate a reference detector, or infer a geometry
relation from design identity or row order.}

\Req{026}{Gauge preservation}{Every geometry realization shall preserve the
declared origin/recentering translation, basis, handedness, tangent versus
coordinate-increment meaning, and conventional pivot parent.}

\Req{027}{Current field rotation}{AST shall evaluate the selected versioned
field-rotation relation at the current aligned occurrence time/elevation and
other declared current state, within its exact support.}

\Req{028}{Rotation support}{A geometry or rotation value outside its declared
time, elevation, or domain support shall be unavailable; AST shall not clamp,
extrapolate, or replace it with an unversioned field-rotation relation.}

\Req{029}{Affine and pivot availability}{Unknown pivot covariance or
unresolved translation, scale, skew, shear, or other affine terms shall retain
typed unavailability/bounds and shall not be set silently to zero or identity.}

\Req{030}{Same-realization key}{Every pointing-support observation and the
science observation receiving its correction shall have identical
$K_\gamma$ from Equation~\ref{eq:geometry-key}, unless Requirement~031 is
satisfied.}

\Req{031}{Authorized equivalence transform}{A cross-realization transform
shall name both immutable parents, prove equivalence over a declared detector/
time/elevation domain, act in the correct direction and units, propagate
covariance, cross-covariance and transform uncertainty, and record authority,
version, validity, and failure behavior.}

\Req{032}{Incompatible transfer failure}{Absent the complete transform in
Requirement~031, any mismatch in $K_\gamma$ shall make the dependent
correction/coordinate unavailable without rewriting unrelated ALIGN or signal
facts.}

\Req{033}{Noncommuting order}{AST shall apply the eight operations in
Section~\ref{sec:ordered-composition} in their stated order and retain each
stage's exact parents.}

\Req{034}{No duplicate operation}{Composition history and application counts
shall prevent any pointing, geometry, rotation, frame, RTC, or upstream
coordinate correction from being applied twice.}

\Req{035}{Bounded small-angle operator}{Production use of
Equation~\ref{eq:small-angle} shall require a preregistered field/elevation/
time domain, detector population, coordinate and pixel metric, named use,
tolerance owner/value, spherical oracle/version, and fail-closed behavior;
AST shall invent neither a universal threshold nor an automatic fallback.}

\subsection{Direction, frame, topology, and projection}

\Req{036}{Vector direction identity}{A sky direction shall be represented by a
finite normalizable unit vector in one declared frame; longitude alone shall
not establish direction at a pole.}

\Req{037}{Longitude-component type}{Every longitude-like correction or offset
shall declare coordinate-increment or on-sky tangent meaning and shall be
normalized according to Equation~\ref{eq:longitude-normalization}.}

\Req{038}{Circular topology}{Longitude differences shall use the exact
$[-P/2,P/2)$ convention in Equation~\ref{eq:wrap}; persisted longitude shall
use Equation~\ref{eq:norm} in its declared unit interval. Exactly antipodal
interpolation shall be unavailable without an explicit unwrap authority.}

\Req{039}{Product-family frame split}{Point, OOF, and Beammap shall use native
AltAz tangent azimuth/elevation coordinates in arcseconds; Science shall use
explicitly identified equatorial J2000 TAN coordinates in degrees.}

\Req{040}{Named frame transform}{Every non-identity frame operation shall name
source/target frames, epoch/equinox, time scale, site, model/version,
EOP/refraction applicability, required inputs, validity, and uncertainty
availability.}

\Req{041}{No frame relabeling}{Missing or incompatible frame authority shall
make the dependent coordinate unavailable; AST shall not equate J2000, FK5,
ICRS, apparent, observed, or unrefracted frames by name or default.}

\Req{042}{Exact TAN domain}{The forward TAN mathematical domain shall be
finite $D>0$ as in Equation~\ref{eq:tan-forward}; v0.1 shall impose no
universal positive $D_{\min}$.}

\Req{043}{TAN invalidity}{A non-finite direction, $D$, tangent output, or
$D\leq0$ shall produce explicit AST coordinate invalidity and no stale,
center, clamped, or edge-pixel substitute.}

\Req{044}{Projection units and axes}{Tangent outputs shall preserve the exact
frame, ordered axes, topology, and units in Equations~\ref{eq:altaz-plane}
and~\ref{eq:science-plane}.}

\subsection{Physical center, WCS, and pixel facts}

\Req{045}{Center selection authority}{Every WCS shall bind the exact physical
center and selection/product-plan identity supplied by a named upstream
target/product authority.}

\Req{046}{No center inference}{AST automatic WCS shall never search, fit,
recenter, derive a center from map bounds, or default a missing/ambiguous
center; the affected WCS shall be unavailable.}

\Req{047}{Legacy all-zero adapter}{Only the exact all-zero pattern across all
six named legacy CRPIX/CRVAL/TAN controls shall adapt to internal
\texttt{automatic}; the adapter and original request shall be recorded.}

\Req{048}{Unsupported explicit WCS}{A nonzero or non-finite legacy explicit
WCS control request shall fail at v0.1 admission as unsupported; numeric zero
outside the exact six-field adapter shall remain an ordinary value.}

\Req{049}{Immutable WCS identity}{The realized WCS shall bind projection,
center authority, CRVAL, one-based CRPIX, CD or equivalent PC+CDELT, axis
order/sign/rotation/handedness, dimensions/bounds, units, frame/epoch,
precision, product plan, and version.}

\Req{050}{Nonsingular continuous WCS}{The CD-equivalent matrix shall be finite
and nonsingular, and continuous FITS coordinates shall satisfy
Equation~\ref{eq:wcs}; hidden transpose, flip, or axis exchange shall fail
directional checks.}

\Req{051}{Reference-pixel policy}{When the center policy is geometric array
center, CRPIX shall satisfy Equation~\ref{eq:crpix}; any other declared policy
shall still place CRVAL exactly at its one-based CRPIX and shall be recorded.}

\Req{052}{Index bases}{FITS pixel centers and zero-based local storage indices
shall obey Equation~\ref{eq:index-base}; local row $j$ shall never be used as
the stable ALIGN slot $s$ or another external identity, and a consumer shall
not infer one convention from the other.}

\Req{053}{Nominal pixel rule}{When requested, the v0.1 nominal containing
pixel shall obey the half-open nearest-center rule in
Equation~\ref{eq:pixel-assignment}, or shall name a separately versioned rule
with equivalent boundary tests.}

\Req{054}{Bounds separation}{Continuous coordinate validity, nominal discrete
pixel identity, in-bounds/out-of-bounds state, MAP support/coverage, and
coordinate precision shall remain distinct facts.}

\Req{055}{Non-finite pixel behavior}{A non-finite continuous coordinate or
pixel shall be invalid and shall never be cast to an integer, mapped to an
edge, or retained from a prior occurrence.}

\subsection{Validity, atomic output, products, and lifecycle}

\Req{056}{Dedicated AST validity}{Direction, tangent, continuous-pixel,
nominal-pixel, and RTC coordinate roles shall each publish a dedicated AST
coordinate-validity cause and exact reason, distinct from ALIGN and downstream
states.}

\Req{057}{Dependency-limited failure}{A missing or invalid required input shall
make only its dependent coordinate/product/claim unavailable unless the
required product contract demands whole-product failure; WCS failure shall not
erase a valid direction or tangent fact, pixel failure shall not erase a valid
tangent fact, and no failure shall rewrite unrelated exact relations.}

\Req{058}{Role-factored atomic records}{Each direction, tangent,
continuous-pixel, nominal-pixel, or RTC role shall publish its value, exact
layered parent, validity, uncertainty/Jacobian availability, and provenance
atomically. A family contract may additionally require an atomic complete
product without collapsing the individual scientific facts or causes.}

\Req{059}{Required-output failure}{Failure to construct or write a required
coordinate role, WCS, provenance, or product shall fail the required product
and reduction; partial or mislabeled product output shall not be success, but
valid upstream role facts and their exact causes shall remain reportable.}

\Req{060}{Typed optional absence}{An optional, unsupported, or unavailable
coordinate role, Jacobian, $I^{\rm geom}_{pi}$, or $G_{pi}$ product shall
carry its exact typed state and reason and shall not masquerade as a complete
role record or family product.}

\Req{061}{Full and mini TOD truth}{Full TOD may retain coordinate arrays with
compact interpretation/validity state; mini TOD shall declare coordinate
arrays unavailable rather than silently omit their meaning.}

\Req{062}{Complete replacement}{Observation resolution shall build a complete
immutable candidate before atomic replacement; failure shall leave no partial
or prior AST state usable by the next observation.}

\Req{063}{Sequential/parallel equivalence}{Under the declared numerical
policy, sequential and parallel schedules shall produce identical per-parent
coordinates, nominal pixels, validity, counts, WCS identity, and deterministic
provenance order.}

\Req{064}{Real/simulation parity}{Supported real and simulation paths shall use
the same equations, support, wrap, index, validity, and output-failure rules;
simulation shall differ only through explicit origin/generator provenance.}

\subsection{Map-center Jacobian and uncertainty}

\Req{065}{Typed Jacobian schema}{Every available
\texttt{astrometric\_map\_center\_jacobian} shall bind exact input domain,
output codomain, direction, axis order, units, center/WCS/product parents,
family, approximation domain, method/version, and included/unavailable terms.}

\Req{066}{Family request gate}{The map-center Jacobian shall be typed
unavailable until a named product family requests its exact domain, codomain,
axis order, units, and direction.}

\Req{067}{Center-only scope}{V0.1 shall evaluate the Jacobian only at the
declared map center and shall not create per-sample, per-detector, per-pixel,
response-grid, dense, or broadly composed astrometric response/covariance.}

\Req{068}{Response exclusions}{The AST Jacobian shall not be labeled or used
as a source-amplitude, beam, RTC temporal, MAP transfer, or point-source
response.}

\Req{069}{Available covariance only}{AST shall transform only declared
available map-center covariance and cross-covariance terms using the typed
realized derivative; unavailable terms shall remain unavailable.}

\Req{070}{No unjustified total}{A total map-center covariance shall be formed
only when all claimed components, cross-covariances, conditioning, and
combination assumptions are declared.}

\Req{071}{Native tangent uncertainty}{When native tangent uncertainty is the
product quantity, AST shall preserve it with its frame, basis, units, parent,
conditioning, and availability rather than relabel it as another domain.}

\Req{072}{Selection uncertainty}{Discrete selection/availability uncertainty
shall not be converted to Gaussian covariance without a separately approved
model and parent.}

\subsection{ALIGN-grid, RTC-grid, and MAP handoff}

\Req{073}{ALIGN-grid coordinate parents}{$\theta^A_{ds}$ shall bind stable
slot $(o,s)$, never local row $j$. Its direction parent shall bind the exact
ALIGN profile/plan/grid/source relation, detector occurrence, observing state,
correction, geometry/rotation realization, and frame. Tangent, pixel, and
nominal-pixel roles shall extend that identity only as specified by
Equations~\ref{eq:tangent-parent}--\ref{eq:nominal-pixel-parent}.}

\Req{074}{RTC-grid coordinate parent}{$\theta^{\rm RTC}_{dn}$ shall extend the
appropriate exact ALIGN-grid direction, tangent, or pixel role and bind the
exact RTC product/plan/grid and all facts in Equation~\ref{eq:rtc-parent}, even
when it numerically equals a phase-zero representative stable ALIGN slot.}

\Req{075}{RTC fact completeness}{The RTC parent shall include selected
direction/tangent/pixel role; owner, product, plan, version, detector and
stable output sample; representative stable ALIGN slot; selected output time,
scale, support, uncertainty, phase/delay sign, unit, value and count; segment,
decimation factor, phase and support; correction state, temporal response, and
status/reasons.}

\Req{076}{No RTC reconstruction}{AST shall not infer or reconstruct RTC plan,
grid, cadence, phase, delay, time shift, representative stable ALIGN slot,
selected coordinate role, segment, decimation support, response, or correction
state from shape or numerical coincidence.}

\Req{077}{No repeated upstream operation}{Constructing
$\theta^{\rm RTC}_{dn}$ shall not repeat ALIGN, reapply an RTC/upstream
coordinate correction, silently reuse pre-RTC time, or promote an unavailable
upstream role by borrowing a downstream WCS or pixel fact.}

\Req{078}{Full RTC sky-response support}{A response-aware consumer shall retain
the RTC temporal operator and the full contributing set of ALIGN-grid
coordinates; it shall not replace them by one nominal output coordinate.}

\Req{079}{No angular signal filtering}{AST shall not apply RTC signal
coefficients directly to angular coordinates as a representation of filtered
sky response, consistent with Equation~\ref{eq:not-angular-filter}.}

\Req{080}{Projection ownership}{AST shall own TAN/WCS astrometric projection
and continuous coordinate facts; MAP shall own sample-to-pixel deposition/
gridding selection, numerical operator, support, normalization, boundaries,
conservation, response, covariance, accumulation, cropping, and reprojection.}

\Req{081}{Candidate versus deposition gate}{AST may publish separately named
$I^{\rm geom}_{pi}$ as geometry-only incidence, neighbor stencil, or candidate
pixel support, but it shall carry no numerical-contribution meaning,
normalization or conservation claim, MAP-support or validity meaning,
response, or covariance authority. AST may materialize $G_{pi}$ only for a
complete exact MAP-owned request naming kernel family, parameters, support,
normalization, edge/boundary behavior, conservation claim, requested artifact
form, response/covariance role, plan identity, and version.}

\Req{082}{Delegated parentage}{Every exact materialized $G_{pi}$ shall bind the exact
AST coordinate parent, WCS/pixel geometry, exact RTC output-grid parent when
applicable, and exact MAP projection-plan parent as in
Equation~\ref{eq:gpi-parentage}.}

\Req{083}{No ownership transfer}{AST materialization shall neither select nor
authorize estimator-specific $G_{pi}$ and shall not transfer MAP scientific
ownership to AST.}

\subsection{Provenance, availability, and verification obligations}

\Req{084}{Requested provenance}{Requested provenance shall retain exact
accepted values and source identities, pointing pairs/support, center,
projection, scale, orientation, dimensions, products, and inactive expert
values.}

\Req{085}{Effective provenance}{Effective provenance shall retain activation,
normalized units/topology, sign adapter, support policy, WCS request state,
projection family, compatibility decisions, and their versions.}

\Req{086}{Observation-resolved provenance}{Observation-resolved provenance
shall retain observation/detector/geometry/ALIGN/RTC identities as applicable,
support bracket, frame operator, field origins/validity, center authority,
exact WCS/bounds, approximation record, and uncertainty availability.}

\Req{087}{Realized provenance}{Realized provenance shall retain applied
support and endpoint identities, occurrence and product counts, exclusions and
reasons, coordinate extrema/wrap events, exact serialized WCS, algorithm and
contract versions, unavailable terms, required-output outcomes, product links,
and artifact digests.}

\Req{088}{Reconstructible compactness}{Compact provenance may reuse stable
ALIGN-grid and detector bindings, but shall reconstruct every policy decision
and bind each persisted coordinate/product to its exact parents and versions.}

\Req{089}{Empirical gates}{Small-angle, time-representation, and large-array
precision adequacy shall be tested against preregistered domains, metrics,
tolerances, owners, oracles, and failure rules; a required-data skip shall not
be counted as a pass.}

\Req{090}{Claim separation}{Scientific-contract authorship, implementation
conformity, representation fidelity, empirical validation, observational
performance, freeze, and production readiness shall remain separate claims;
this Stage B draft shall assert none of the latter claims.}
